name: Good Gamer Entertainment Inc.
summary: Good Gamer Entertainment Inc. offers an online platform for managing esports, skill-based, and real-money gaming tournaments, operating in both Canada and the United States. The company's activities are divided into segments including Display Advertisements, its proprietary Tournament Management Platform (TMP), Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs), and Corporate and Development. Its central offering is a web-based system that empowers game developers to incorporate real-money social competitions into their Unity-powered mobile games, allowing them to organize casual esports events where mobile users can compete for cash prizes. Furthermore, Good Gamer is involved in the creation and advancement of "Chosen Ones" NFTs, encompassing their artwork, characters, and a blockchain-based play-to-earn game. The company also develops a software platform for data collection and management. Good Gamer Entertainment Inc. is based in Vancouver, Canada.
